title: Special Topics in History; The Early Silk Road and the World of the Indian Ocean
description: An investigation of an interconnected Afro-Eurasian world in antiquity. Explores trade routes and cultural exchange conducted by land (the so-called Silk Road ) and sea (the western Indian Ocean) from the BronzeAge through the early centuries CE. Students will learn how ancient political economies interlock, encounter the ideologies and faiths born of the exchange of ideas, trace the movement of commodities across vast distances, and celebrate the human agents that facilitated these connections across space and time.
